evidence_required: the sample size in requests and gaps, the correlation argument, and one better instrument.

marking.criterion: Sample size: about 227 requests and about 72k gaps; p99.9 rests on about 72 points
Correlation argument: gaps within a request (and across co-scheduled requests) are correlated, so effective sample size is much smaller
Conclusion (usable for trends, not SLO compliance) and one better instrument (higher sampling, per-request max ITL)

title: What a 5 % ITL sample can show
